items.title: 19.2 Hydrocarbons (sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of hydrocarbons and their classes (PDF 39-40).

blocks.title: Hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Hydrocarbons woh compounds hain jin mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon.

items: Khuli zanjeer (acyclic) wale hydrocarbons aam taur par aliphatic kehlate hain (Yunani aleiphatos, yani charbi, se, kyunke charbi ki banawat khuli zanjeer wali hai). Yeh saturated (alkanes) ya unsaturated (alkenes aur alkynes) hote hain.

Band zanjeer (cyclic) wale hydrocarbons mein carbon atoms ke halqe hote hain. Alicyclic hydrocarbons, saturated ya unsaturated, aliphatic ki tarah rawaiya rakhte hain, maslan cycloalkanes aur cycloalkenes. Aromatic hydrocarbons mein benzene ring ya us jaisi banawat hoti hai, maslan benzene, naphthalene aur diphenylmethane.

blocks.alt: Darakht: hydrocarbons (sirf C aur H) khuli zanjeer aliphatic (saturated alkanes; unsaturated alkenes aur alkynes) aur band zanjeer cyclic (alicyclic aur aromatic) mein bat'te hain. Neeche misalein: ethane CH3-CH3, ethene H2C=CH2, ethyne HC teehra bond CH; cyclohexane; benzene, methylbenzene aur naphthalene.
blocks.caption: Hydrocarbons ki taqseem (kitab ke chart aur misalon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hydrocarbons pehle carbon dhaanche se taqseem hote hain: khuli zanjeer (aliphatic) ya halqe (cyclic). Aliphatic hydrocarbons saturated, sirf single bonds wale, ya unsaturated, double ya triple bonds wale, ho sakte hain. Cyclic hydrocarbons alicyclic, aliphatic jaisa rawaiya rakhne wale, ya aromatic, benzene jaise halqon wale, hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Methylcyclohexane, aik methylcyclohexene, methylbenzene, naphthalene aur cyclohexane ko aliphatic, alicyclic ya aromatic mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation: Methylcyclohexane, methylcyclohexene aur cyclohexane alicyclic hain; methylbenzene aur naphthalene aromatic hain.

items: Cyclic: alicyclic (maslan cyclohexane) ya aromatic (benzene rings).
